dishes.name: Luzerner Chügelipastete
dishes.desc: Puff-pastry case filled with small meatballs, mushrooms and cream sauce. Traditional in Lucerne since the 18th century and found in the city's old restaurants.

dishes.name: Älplermagronen
dishes.desc: Macaroni baked with potato, cheese, cream and onion, served with apple sauce. The Alpine herders' dish of central Switzerland, which Lucerne restaurants cook as a staple.

dishes.name: Luzerner Lebkuchen
dishes.desc: Spiced pear-juice honey bread, a Lucerne winter sweet. Its pear syrup comes from the orchards of the Lucerne hinterland.

dishes.name: Birewegge
dishes.desc: Pear bread, a pastry stuffed with dried pears, walnuts, figs and raisins. A traditional central Swiss speciality that is eaten around Lucerne.

dishes.name: Rüeblitorte
dishes.desc: Carrot and almond cake, a Swiss classic baked in Lucerne's bakeries. It is often glazed with marzipan carrots.
